scope: User-authorized human sound playback and microphone connection check, 100 Hz to 20 kHz
user_reported_connection: Earthworks microphone on Audient input 1; physical 48 V switch state was initially unknown

observations.test_tone: A live input-1 FFT peak at approximately 996 Hz was displayed during the 0.5-second 1 kHz playback. The strongest frame in the held summary was at an ambient low frequency; no tone SNR is inferred.
observations.sweep: Five-second logarithmic 100 Hz to 20 kHz sweep completed. The latest held browser summary contained 91 observed analyser frames.
observations.capture_finished: Microphone off; input tracks released. Playback status Finished.

analysis_limits: Time-domain and FFT statistics come from overlapping browser analyser windows and may include ambient sound, handling and harmonics. The reported maximum is not a calibrated response point. No raw room audio was saved. This is evidence of an input signal and 1 kHz test pickup, not verification of complete 100 Hz to 20 kHz speaker/microphone response, calibrated SPL, distortion, acoustic timing or animal suitability.
